The user wants to mark compilation errors from the bottom console with a red line in the left margin of the editor at the exact line of the error.
The previous investigations (T1, T2, T3) found that the current mechanism for marking errors in the editor comes from the LSP (Language Server Protocol) via `ISymbol Provider`, not from parsing the console output.
T2 explicitly states: "los errores no se leen de la consola, sino que provienen del LSP".
T3 confirms: "no encontré la lectura de errores de compilación de la consola".
